run_standalone_benchmark: run a standalone TaoBench benchmark with synchronized server and client on localhost
launch_server: launch a TaoBench server instance with configurable port, CPU binding, and memory binding options
launch_client: launch a TaoBench client by extracting the real command from a benchpress dry-run output
init_parser: initialize an argparse parser with synchronized port and memory size arguments for server and client
exec_cmd: execute a shell command via subprocess and capture stdout, stderr, and the exit code
